title: Descemet Stripping Automated Endothelial Keratoplasty in Thick Corneas

indication: Corneal endothelial dysfunction: pseudophakic bullous keratopathy 21/30, Fuchs endothelial dystrophy 4/30, blunt trauma 3/30, CHED 2/30; triple-DSAEK in 6/30; previous keratoplasty and glaucoma drainage devices excluded

groups.description: DSAEK (Moria ALTK lenticule, Busin glide) in eyes with preoperative corneal thickness at or below 820 µm (the cohort median)
groups.indication: baseline condition subgroup: preoperative corneal thickness ≤ 820 µm

groups.description: DSAEK (Moria ALTK lenticule, Busin glide) in eyes with preoperative corneal thickness above 820 µm
groups.indication: baseline condition subgroup: preoperative corneal thickness > 820 µm

series.baseline_label: Donor ECD (Table 1) quantified with an EB-3000 XYZ eye-bank specular microscope during Optisol-GS storage (Methods 2.2)
series.notes: mean ± SD; reference from Table 1, follow-ups from Table 2; per-visit n not reported

series.baseline_label: Donor ECD (Table 1) quantified with an EB-3000 XYZ eye-bank specular microscope during Optisol-GS storage (Methods 2.2)
series.notes: mean ± SD; reference from Table 1, follow-ups from Table 2; per-visit n not reported

notes: Retrospective study of 30 eyes of 30 patients (2017-2018), two corneal surgeons; groups split at the median preoperative corneal thickness, a baseline patient condition, so both are control.
Postoperative ECD was measured by laser confocal microscopy (HRT-3), a different device from the eye-bank specular count used for the donor reference.
ECD recorded before surgery (donor) and at 1 and 12 months after surgery.
